rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a place or route with beautiful scenery.

example.english: This hiking trail is incredibly scenic.
example.traditional: 呢條行山路風景靚到不得了。
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 haang4 saan1 lou6 fung1 ging2 leng3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5

rows.note: Use this formal description in writing or polished speech, especially for guidebooks and travel descriptions.

example.english: This travel guide introduces a scenic little town.
example.traditional: 呢本旅遊書介紹咗一個風景優美嘅小鎮。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 leoi5 jau4 syu1 gaai3 siu6 zo2 jat1 go3 fung1 ging2 jau1 mei5 ge3 siu2 zan3
